identitySignals: OUSD Legistar file 24-1406 lists a Services Agreement with STEMSoul Teach, LLC of Los Angeles, CA for summer instructor training, matching the agenda text and location

The Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County's Teacher Advisory Council page names STEMSoul TEACH, LLC, directed by DeAnna Lee-Rivers, and describes afterschool programs and summer camps, matching OUSD's after-school and summer program contracts
stemsoulteach.org describes curriculum development and teacher training and uses the same 'born from the belief' wording as the museum page's description of STEMSoul TEACH, LLC

Not confirmed: a separate nonprofit, STEMSOUL, INC. (California entity C4647505, EIN 85-4236716), is run by the same person, but no page cited here shows it is the same legal entity as the LLC, so no registry IDs are given
research.notes: The website does not state a legal entity type and shows no phone, email or address. A similarly named nonprofit, STEMSOUL, INC. (Diamond Bar/Los Angeles, CA), exists with the same director, but the link to STEMSoul TEACH, LLC is unverified, so registry IDs were left out. Confidence is medium because the website-to-LLC link rests on matching wording and name only.

profile.summary: STEMSoul develops science, technology, engineering and math (STEM) curriculum and teacher training programs. It uses a social justice approach and hands-on, culturally responsive learning. It also develops learning experiences for afterschool programs and summer camps.
